```php
<?php namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use App\Models\Expense;

class DashboardComponent extends Component
{
    public $expenses = [];
    public $newExpense = [];

    protected $rules = [
        'newExpense.name' => 'required|string|max:255',
        'newExpense.amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
    ];

    public function mount()
    {
        $this->expenses = Expense::where('user_id', Auth::id())->get();
    }

    public function store()
    {
        $this->validate();

        Expense::create([
            'name' => $this->newExpense['name'],
            'amount' => $this->newExpense['amount'],
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
        ]);

        $this->newExpense = [];
        session()->flash('success', 'Expense added successfully!');
    }

    public function delete($expense)
    {
        Expense::destroy($expense);
        session()->flash('success', 'Expense deleted successfully!');
    }
}
```
